body:
Source revision for 13fb8907-3153-411e-9972-a88c75330fd3 is pushed on codex/mask-pending-retention at 639da049. Original candidate/history preserved. Tests-first commit e4ffb7b3 adds four deterministic UNRUN tests (11 total); product b7af2073 implements successful asynchronous follow-on drain and obsolete task invalidation. Diff: git diff aa4a5841..639da049 -- apps/mac/Sources/TesseraCore/Develop/DevelopController+Masks.swift apps/mac/Tests/TesseraCoreTests/DevelopMaskPendingRetentionTests.swift.

One MainActor task per controller, one batch per task. Only success plus remaining pending work schedules a successor. Works without a handler or with a synchronous handler. Explicit consuming flush removes/cancels queued generation before attempt; UUID guard makes stale tasks inert even after an intervening rejection/newer generation. Weak controller capture; registry entry removed before drain. No automatic follow-on after any failed batch. Internal read-only scheduledMaskFlushTask lets tests await actual scheduled work without sleeps/manual successful follow-on flushes.

New tests cover nil/synchronous handlers with two reentrant generations across brush/component/group/param, stale queued task invalidation before explicit rejected attempt, and rejection suppressing reentrant retry. Source checks only: git diff --check passed, working tree clean. All 11 tests UNRUN; compile unverified. A source review withholding acceptance was not a runtime failure. A must compile/review/merge. No B workloads or heartbeat restart. A-owned DevelopController.swift/AppModel untouched.

Bounds are one queued task and batch at a time, not finite total tasks under endlessly arriving successful edits. Existing close recovery, noninteractive/structural changes and begin/end-stroke recovery stay out of scope. Details in tools/orchestrate/wp/B5-16/MASK-RETENTION-HANDOFF.md.
